meta.what: Which printed line of each company is the counterpart of each regulator aggregate (Pensia-Net new+general funds / Gemel-Net / Bituach-Net), with document, page and URL. Read by pipeline/build_recon.py.
meta.units: v, parts, out, minus, tot: NIS millions. unit: the unit the document prints. prec: printed precision in NIS millions.

fields.fam: pension | gemel | pg (pension+gemel, used only where the report prints one combined figure)
fields.v: the printed counterpart: one line, or the sum of the printed lines in parts
fields.out: printed lines of the same table that are outside the regulator set (veteran pension funds are not in Pensia-Net new+general)
fields.minus: printed line deducted from v because the regulator files list it under a manager the site maps to another group; each with its page
fields.tot: the total the table prints, for reference
fields.own: the figure is of the balance-sheet date of its own report (false: a comparative column of a later report)
fields.origin: read = read from the page for this map; auto = parsed from the page text by pattern; series / savings_econ = already extracted in the site data

meta.verified: every v / part / out / minus / tot was found as printed on the stated page of the stated document (page text of the filed PDF)
